description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to webhooks for execution events, including webhook state management, payload structure, and lifecycle states.

classes.name: ExecutionWebhook
classes.description: Represents persisted webhook registration data for an execution, including URL, headers, status, retry info, and timestamps.

classes.name: ExecutionWebhookStateUpdate
classes.description: Contains mutable fields for recording delivery attempts, such as status, attempt count, timestamps, and errors.

classes.name: ExecutionWebhookPayload
classes.description: Defines the payload structure sent to webhook consumers, including event info, execution details, and results.

methods.name: CloneWithoutSecret
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of an ExecutionWebhook object without including the secret, copying all other fields.
